subject_description: a hulking berserker knight in black spiked plate armor with a horned helm, a torn red cape and a gigantic jagged black greatsword
initial_pose: standing facing the camera, the gigantic greatsword resting on his right shoulder
description: a heavy, powerful running cycle in place running toward the camera: big strides, knees driving up, the heavy armored body bobbing up and down, the free left arm with chains pumping, the gigantic greatsword stays resting on his right shoulder the whole time, the torn red cape flowing behind him; a seamless loop, he stays in the middle of the picture.
